policies.text: Returns and refunds: unused products can be returned within 7 days of delivery. Gold members have 14 days. The original invoice is required. Shipping fees are not refundable.
Shipping and delivery: standard delivery takes 3 to 5 business days. Orders above INR 2000 receive free standard shipping.
Warranty: USB-C hubs and wireless mice have a 12 month warranty for manufacturing defects. Accidental damage is excluded.
Invoices: prices exclude GST. The demo GST rate is 18 percent. Invoices include customer ID, order ID, line items, subtotal, tax and total in INR.
